references.text: The parable of the workers in the vineyard reflects the idea of reward based on God's grace, not on the length or difficulty of the work.
God's kingdom is open to all, regardless of when they come to faith, just like the workers who were hired at different times during the day.
Many who are first will be last, and the last first; this theme is reflected in the parable of the workers in the vineyard.
This verse also emphasizes the idea that the last will be first, and the first last, which is a central theme in the parable.
